definitions.explanation: Used to add more information or emphasize an increase in degree.
Indicates an increase beyond the current state.

examples.japanese: {更|さら}に{詳|くわ}しく{説明|せつめい}します。
examples.english: I will explain in further detail.

examples.japanese: {値段|ねだん}が{更|さら}に{上|あ}がった。
{彼|かれ}は{成功|せいこう}し、{更|さら}に{有名|ゆうめい}になった。
examples.english: He succeeded and became even more famous.

notes:
USAGE: {更|さら}に can introduce additional information (like "moreover") or indicate an increase in degree (like "even more").

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{更|さら}に〜する (to do ~ even more)
・{更|さら}に{詳|くわ}しく (in more detail)
・{更|さら}に{加|くわ}えて (in addition to that)

CONTRAST:
・{更|さら}に - furthermore, even more (formal)
・もっと - more (general, casual)
・その{上|うえ} - on top of that, moreover
・しかも - moreover, what's more
